Commentary.Commentary: Every Lankan would have hoped for Dilshan to shine but alas, it was not his day. Instead, de Silva stepped up to the crease and hung in there, scoring a hard-earned 62, to guide his side through the bowling onslaught. Zampa and Faulkner were the men to get the crucial breakthroughs early on, taking vital 3-wicket hauls each. Do join us shortly for the run chase.

Sri Lanka's hopes for a victorious end to the tour look dubious after the innings that we just witnessed. The Australian bowlers cut into them repeatedly, never allowing a partnership of note to form. Their fielding was as sharp as ever too, with several fantastic catches and run out opportunities seized. The Lankans have set a below par target that shouldn't be too much of a challenge to chase.
Full and angled in, lofted over mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket. Sananayake finds the gap and the ball goes into deep mid-wicket before it is stopped. The batsmen get a couple.
SURANGA LAKMAL walks in next.

OUT! Another good catch by an Australian fielder today. This time it's James Faulkner! Full toss outside off, de Silva looks to loft it over the off side but doesn't time it well at all. Faulkner from mid off runs to his left and takes a very good catch near extra cover. Starc gets his first and de Silva's fine knock comes to an end.
Short outside off, de Silva goes for a wild punch but misses.
Full on off, driven down the ground for a single.
Fullish ball wide outside off, Senanayake looks to play it but is beaten.
Angled in and wide down the leg side, Senanayake goes after it but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
STARC is back on.
Fullish ball outside off, lofted over mid on for a single.
Free Hit coming up...

Bouncer! Senanayake ducks under the bouncer at the last moment. The umpire has signalled a no ball for the second bouncer of the over. Hastings and Warner have a quick word with the umpire before settling down.
Well struck! Short on the stumps, de Silva launches a cracking pull shot and sends the ball to mid-wicket for a single.
Short outside off and much quicker, the ball glances off the bat and goes to third man.
Very short outside off, left alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Length ball on the stumps, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, lofted through the covers for a couple.
Fullish ball on the stumps, worked to the leg side. There is a run out attempt at the bowler's end. If that one had hit, Sennanayake was out by miles.
SACHITHRA SENANAYAKE is the new man in.

OUT! UP AND OUT!  Full on the stumps, Prasanna lofts it high over mid on. Usman Khawaja gets in place and pouches the ball. There is a moment when he stumbles but recovers and Sri Lanka lose another wicket.
Fullish ball on leg, nudged to the leg side for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away for a single.
Fullish ball on the pads, flicked down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! DE SILVA ON THE CHARGE! Fullish ball on middle and off, de Silva charges forward to slog it. He gets a top edge and the ball crosses the ropes at third man.
Length ball on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region for a single.
Outside off, de Silva defends it from the crease to the off side. The batmen take a single.
Maiden T20I fifty for Dhananjaya de Silva.
Length ball outside off, played to point for a single. This had been a hard won fifty for de Silva and well deserved!
Full toss outside off, punched off the front foot to the covers for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, de Silva looks to drive it through the covers but inside edges it to mid on for a single.
Full and wide outside off, de Silva looks slash it but misses.
Wide! A slower delivery angled in, it goes down the leg side for a wide. That brings up 100 for SL!
STARC is back on.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Goes back and works it through square leg and charges back for the second. There is a good throw at the keeper's end and Nevill breaks the stumps and appeals. It is referred upstairs and replays show that de Silva has dived in.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A short ball around off, Prasanna looks to pull but misses.Faulkner appeals but nothing from the umpire.  Replays detect the ball hitting the pocket.
Landed outside off, defended watchfully.
FAULKNER is back on.
FOUR! FLAT BATTED! Short outside off, punched between mid off and the covers and the ball crosses the ropes. Well hit!
Another short ball on middle and off, pulled to the leg side for a single.
Short and a tad outside off, punched to point.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Short around off, pulled through square leg for a single.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! THAT WAS EASILY DONE! Back of a length ball on middle and off, Pathirana looks to pull it off the front foot to the leg side. The ball takes a top edge though and is lobbed to short extra cover. Hastings runs to his left and takes an easy catch. Another soft dismissal for the hosts.
HASTINGS is back on.
Length ball otuside off, pushed to backward point for a single. SL are just about surviving.

FOUR! EDGY! Shortish ball outside off, Pathirana plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The ball narrowly goes past the keeper and makes it to the fence. Moises is not happy about it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another short ball and de Silva pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot to point for a single.
Short and slower outside off, looks to play it but misses. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Full on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
HENRIQUES is back on.
Full on off, driven to mid on.
SACHITH PATHIRANA is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT FOR A DUCK! Shortish ball outside off and spinning back in, Thisara looks to pull it. The ball is high in the air and it looks like it might go for a maximum but then comes back down to square leg. Travis Head is waiting for it and cups his hands. at the ropes. That is yet another wicket for Zampa!
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot.
THISARA PERERA is the new man in.

OUT! Another terrific catch by Warner! Shortish ball around off, Kapugedera swings his bat without a clear plan. The ball sails low and parallel to the ground to Warner at mid-wicket. Warner dives forward and takes a blinder of a catch. The man seems charmed today and nothing is escaping his hands.

NOT OUT! Landed around off, Kapugedera tries to turn it across but misses it completely. The keeper collects the ball and whips off the bails in a flash and appeals. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show Kapugedera got back in time.
Appeal for a stumping referred upstairs. Nevill looks confident.
Loopy ball on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, punched to mid off for a single.
Landed outside off, played to point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on off, worked to square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, de Silva plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! DELICATELY DONE! Fullish on the pads, de Silva nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Floated down the leg side, de Silva gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. One run added to the total.

NOT OUT. Kapugedera plays it to mid-wicket. The fielder aims a direct throw and it hits the stumps at the bowler's end. There is an appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs but the replay shows that the batsman is back inside.
There is an appeal for a run out which is referred upstairs...
Flighted wide outside off, de Silva lofts it over mid off for a single.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Loopy full toss on leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
This one comes back in from outside off, Dhananjaya waits for it and guides it to third man for a run.
Outside off, tapped to the off side for a quick single.
Outside off, played straight to point.

Down the leg side, Kapugedera tucks it towards fine leg where the fielder does well to slide and stop the ball. However, some poor running is on display as the batsmen take just a couple. Three runs were available.
Around middle and off, nipping back in, de Silva misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects away and the batsmen take a single, leg bye signalled.
MOISES HENRIQUES comes into the attack.
Full and outside off, pushed defensively towards covers.
CHAMARA KAPUGEDERA is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! That looked very close and the umpire has raised his finger. After a long time, Zampa manages to pitch it full. Mendis gets down to paddle but misses and is hit on the pads. Zampa is the lone man appealing but that is enough for the umpire as he sends the batsman on his way. Oh dear... HAWK EYE shows it to be PITCHING OUTSIDE LEG! Mendis does not want to go but he has to... walks back with dejection on his face.
A long hop again, pulled straight to short mid-wicket this time.
Outside off, short in length, punched straight to short extra cover.
FOUR! Wham! There comes the one mandatory full toss per over, around off, Mendis reaches out and sweeps it powerfully over mid-wicket, splitting the men in the deep.
Tossed up outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Loopy ball, full outside off, driven to the covers.
Full on leg, nudged to square leg.
Full on the stumps, driven down the ground. The bowler tries to stop it but the batsmen get a single.

NOT OUT. Length ball outside off, de Silva looks to guide it to third man but the fielder at short third man stops it and gets a direct hit at the striker's end. The umpire refers it upstairs and the replays show that the batsman was just inside.
The umpire has referred a run out appeal upstairs.
Short ball on middle, Mendis pulls it hard. The ball take a slight top edge and soars through the air and to the man at deep mid-wicket for a single.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! The skipper departs for 4! Shortish ball on middle and off, Chandimal looks to flick it but plays it too early and the ball takes a leading edge. Faulkner continues running, going to his right and takes a simple catch.
Full outside off, Chandimal drives it through mid off for a single.
Flatter and straight on middle, driven down the ground for a single.
Loopy and full outside off, driven down the ground to the man at long on for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, defended to point. There is a bit of confusion and the batsmen decide not to run.
Floated on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
ADAM ZAMPA to roll his arm.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in.

OUT! That is a stunning catch! David Warner, take a bow... It was a fuller length around off, the off-cutter, Perera looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball goes high in the air but clears mid off. Matthew Wade runs behind from mid off but there is another man running towards him from mid on. It is that man Warner, running like a panther. He keeps his eyes on the ball and Wade backs off. Warner puts in the dive and takes an almost impossible catch. What a take. Brilliant.
On a good length outside off, Kusal feels for it but misses.
Dropped short around middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended back to the bowler.
JAMES FAULKNER to bowl.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! On middle and off, Kusal gets into position quickly and reverse sweeps it again through third man. This time he finds the gap with ease and makes it across the fence.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
FOUR! SLOGGED! De Silva comes down the track and lofts it over the covers for a boundary.
Outside off, de Silva opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a couple.
A similar ball and Kusal looks to reverse sweep it again. This time the batsmen just pick up a single.
FOUR! BEAUTIFULLY SWEPT! Full on middle and leg, Kusal gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it. The ball gets a slight top edge but goes over the fielder at third man for a boundary.
GLENN MAXWELL comes into the attack.
Shortish ball on middle and off, Kusal pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Fullish delivery, Kusal shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shorter ball outside off, Kusal looks to hook it but misses.
De Silva has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball outside off, played to point for a single.

Well fielded! Length ball around off, de Silva punches it off the middle of the bat. The ball looks like it will cross the ropes but the fielder in the deep makes a great diving save. The batsmen run three.
Short delivery, played to point.
FOUR! WHIPPED! Fullish ball on middle and leg, Kusal crouches low and launches into a powerful flick that sails over mid-wicket and across the ropes.
Shortish ball on middle and off, Kusal misjudges the bounce and is hit high on the thigh pad.
Length ball on the stumps, de Silva waits for it and punches it down the ground. Wade chases it from mid on and manages to save the run. The batsmen get a triple.
Full and a tad outside off, de Silva looks to play it down the ground but misses it.
FOUR! PUT AWAY! De Silva is off to a blazing start! Full outside off, he strikes that one solidly to send the ball streaking to the boundary at covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short delivery on the stumps, pulled through the leg side for a single.
Length ball angled in, de Silva looks to play it but the ball beats his inside edge.
Fullish ball on middle, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is the new man in.

OUT! DILSHAN DEPARTS! It is a pity to see him walk off so soon! Back of a length ball and wide outside off, Dilshan stays back and slashes at it. The ball takes a bottom edge near the toe of the bat and sends it to David Warner at first slip. He bends low and pouches it with both hands. Dilshan walks to the ropes, gets down on his knees and with his arms raised, bows down to the crowd who have come out in droves to support him.
Short outside off, Dilshan plays it to the covers.
JOHN HASTINGS to bowl from the other end.
Full around off, Kusal drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked off the pads to square leg for a brace.
Fullish ball outside off, Dilshan looks to drive it but gets an outside edge for a single.
Full outside off, driven to the covers. Wade dives forward to save the runs and the Aussies get a single.
FOUR! Well struck! Kusal starts SL off on a good note! Full and wide outside off, Perera drives it hard and the ball races through the covers.
Down the leg side, Kusal looks to flick it but misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Full and wide outside, Kusal looks to play it but misses.

The players and umpires are out in the middle. TILLAKARATNE DILSHAN gets a guard of honour as he steps out for his final international match. He and KUSAL PERERA are set to open and MITCHELL STARC will begin the bowling proceedings.

Australian captain David Warner says that his side has followed a winning formula so far. He was in two minds regarding the choice of the toss. Says that George Bailey is back home and Matthew Wade has come in and John Hastings replaces Scott Boland. Says he has really enjoyed the tour so far.

Sri Lankan captain Dinesh Chandimal says that 160-plus might be a winning total for his side. Adds that it is a pretty good wicket. (On the previous defeat) Opines that his side has to learn from its mistakes. They have made one change to the side as Seekkuge Prasanna replaces Rajitha.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and elect to bat.

Sri Lankan bowlers will look to make the most of the slower pitch and restrict OZ but they have been plagued with a lack of consistency. The strong Lankan batting lineup looks more comfortable defending than chasing. Australia have dominated in the shorter formats and will look to carry on their punishing streak in this tour. Both sides will be making some changes to their teams so stay tuned for the toss to find out what happens.

Welcome to the 2nd T20I between Sri Lanka and Australia. This is the last match of Australia's tour and the two sides will meet one last time this summer. The pressure is on the Islanders to give Tillakaratne Dilshan a fitting farewell and the Aussies a not-so-pleasant send off. There are a couple of clouds in the air but those don't seem enough to impede play.
